main.description: The title and description of one reading list, stored in the owner's repo inside the list's space. The space itself is the visibility boundary, so there is no per-record ACL here.

community.lexicon.meta.links.description: community.lexicon.meta.links: the web copies of this record, including its social.popfeed.feed.list record. `unknown`, not a ref: the community NSID does not resolve yet, and a ref to it would make this whole lexicon unresolvable.
